description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Water)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant Cast 1] and [Hit & Charge Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Water ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Hit & Charge Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Hit & Charge (Fire/Ice/Water) after using two Fire, Ice or Water abilities if the triggering ability deals Fire/Ice/Water damage
